name: Ananya Reddy
quote: I'd tried diets before that left me starving by 3pm. Following the meal timing here instead of cutting blindly is the only thing that's ever stuck past a month for me.

name: Rohan Mehta
quote: Started in Beginner Bootcamp two months ago not knowing how to brace properly. The form-first approach felt slow at first but it's the reason I haven't gotten hurt once.

name: Lena Cooper
result: Completed her first pull-up at 90 days
quote: I came in after years away from any kind of training. The 30-day plan didn't push me into anything heavy too fast, which is exactly what kept me coming back.

name: Kwame Boateng
quote: Every other plan I'd tried ignored food entirely. Having a real meal structure next to the workout plan is what actually moved the number on the scale this time.
